<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8FCFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="13" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="11" x2="331" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="9" x2="336" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="7" x2="341" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="357" y1="16" x2="361" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="8" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="10" width="12" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="385" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="31,59 22,66 31,73" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="72" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Set up your trip</text>
    <circle cx="361" cy="62" r="17" fill="#DDF4FF"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="58" r="4" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <ellipse cx="361" cy="68" rx="8" ry="4.5" fill="#1899D6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="108" width="358" height="10" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="16" y="108" width="89" height="10" rx="64" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="16" y="141" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="900" fill="#6F6F70">STEP 1 OF 4</text>
    <text x="374" y="141" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">25%</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main introduction -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="181" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="26px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you going?</text>
    <text x="20" y="209" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">Tell us about your trip and we’ll tailor</text>
    <text x="20" y="231" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">your lessons with useful travel phrases.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="270" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Destination</text>
    <rect x="20" y="282" width="350" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="309" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="316" x2="59" y2="322" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="316" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Enter a city or country</text>
    <text x="20" y="363" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change this later in your profile.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- French destination suggestion -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="390" width="350" height="118" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="20" y="388" width="350" height="118" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="38" y="416" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="900" fill="#6F6F70">POPULAR DESTINATION</text>
    <rect x="38" y="430" width="59" height="45" rx="11" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="38" y="430" width="20" height="45" rx="11" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="58" y="430" width="20" height="45" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="78" y="430" width="19" height="45" rx="0" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="113" y="451" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">France</text>
    <text x="113" y="472" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">French travel vocabulary</text>
    <circle cx="342" cy="449" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="336,449 340,453 348,444" fill="none" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip language card -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="550" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Your trip language</text>
    <text x="20" y="576" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">We’ll focus on phrases you can use right away.</text>
    <rect x="20" y="596" width="350" height="78" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="20" y="594" width="350" height="78" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="38" y="611" width="48" height="36" rx="8" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="38" y="611" width="16" height="36" rx="8" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="54" y="611" width="16" height="36" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="70" y="611" width="16" height="36" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="105" y="626" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">French</text>
    <text x="105" y="648" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Selected learning language</text>
    <polyline points="337,626 342,631 351,620" fill="none" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer action -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="700" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Add a destination to continue</text>
    <rect x="20" y="714" width="350" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="744" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Continue</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="778" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="778" x2="374" y2="778" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Learn -->
    <polygon points="42,797 54,787 66,797" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="46" y="796" width="16" height="13" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="54" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Learn</text>
    <!-- Practice -->
    <circle cx="140" cy="798" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="135,798 139,802 146,794" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="140" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="238" cy="793" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="238" cy="805" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="238" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    <!-- More -->
    <circle cx="332" cy="797" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="797" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="797" r="2.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
    <text x="342" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
